svg.title: Custom fields a team defines itself — SoftTrack web design mockup (#117)
svg.desc: Team settings gain Fields: an ordered list of team-scoped fields with a kind, a required flag and the ticket types they apply to. Values show below the built-in properties, required fields are enforced on create, and a user field notifies like assignment.

svg.text: CustomField (team, key, name, kind, options, required, position, archived, applies_to) and CustomFieldValue (ticket, field, value; unique per ticket and field). Values ride the
existing ticket read and patch endpoints, the CSV export and the history. JSON value vs typed columns is the decision to settle first. Filtering by a field is a second phase.
